== Description ==

[[Apollo Chu]] (front left, blue SpongeBob tee), [[Logan Pietig]] (standing center, black UWL hoodie), [[Benji Chu]] (behind Apollo Chu, navy #99 Judge jersey, black cap), [[Chris Wirfs]] (front right, black Solo tee, red shorts, glasses), [[AJ Hatoum]] (standing center-right, olive jacket, khaki pants, glasses), [[Matt Thornton]] (middle-left table facing camera, Galaxy's Edge tee, beard), and [[Garrett Larson]] (standing back right (back), pink cap, navy tee, plaid shorts) at the [[2025 World Championship]] on 3 October 2025.
